axes.concept: Mesa editable: act on measurements, material prices and decoration previews where their effect is seen, keeping the existing Pictures product shell.
axes.layout: Desktop counter is a 1.45:1 working paper with a schematic/measurement surface beside the shopping result; calculator is full-width editable rows followed by an inline totals band; gallery uses expandable horizontal object bands, not a card grid. Home uses two columns with the first tool spanning both.
axes.navigation: Inherited neutral horizontal routes, three in-place counting-method buttons, an explicit measures disclosure, inline expense disclosure and single-expanded decoration preview; each home card still opens its own existing/new tool page.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans / Geist Mono. The inherited page heading is 24px, object headings 20px, body 15px, supporting copy 12–14px and count 28px with tabular figures; no font or identity change.
axes.density: 28px working insets and 20–28px gaps; a continuous professional quote with ruled input rows; gallery bands disclose one full preview at a time. Phone uses 20px insets, stacked fields and full-width object flow.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton and Animate UI Dialog, recomposed as in-place measurement controls, editable material rows and expandable decoration bands; native selectors/details preserve the sibling vocabulary.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures fondo/superficie/texto/acento and Taller surface tokens; existing sibling texto-tenue alias for control edges. Primary colour marks one main action, navigation remains neutral. Both existing themes are mapped to kit roles.
axes.motion: Tactile press/settle: 520ms compressed-paper/object registration with 35ms offsets, 170ms press feedback, 2px/0.965 pressed buttons; diagram settle and preview hinge use cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1). Natural/subtle use 320/140 and 160/100ms. Motion spring uses the installed profile. Reduced/still removes travel and retains every control; hidden/offscreen repeating effects pause.
